Ink Wall Co. prints murals and logos directly onto your wall.

No vinyl. No wallpaper. No seams. A robotic UV printer lays full-color artwork straight onto the surface, so nothing lifts, bubbles or peels. Most walls are finished in a single day, for offices, hotels, restaurants, dental offices and garages across Sacramento and the Bay Area.

Work

Real walls, printed on site. Hover to look closer and click any image to open it full-screen.

Porsche GT3 RS × Private Garage

A car enthusiast's garage, turned into a showroom. The GT3 RS mural, the spec panel and the full-length PORSCHE lettering were printed straight onto the drywall above a black wainscot. There are no panels and no edges, so the car parked in front looks like it drove out of the wall.

Adjust Your Sound × Exhaust Showroom

A motorcycle exhaust brand wanted its showroom to feel as loud as its product. We printed oversized type down a black hallway, a white line-art exhaust drawing on charcoal, and the brand mark in red, all on site under a hexagon-light ceiling.

Better than vinyl. Faster than a muralist. And it lasts.

  1. 01

    No vinyl, no peeling

    Ink goes straight onto the wall. No adhesive means nothing to lift, bubble or curl at the edges.

  2. 02

    No seams

    One continuous print, edge to edge. The wall keeps its own texture, so it reads as part of the space.

  3. 03

    Done in a day

    Minimal prep and no drying racks. Most walls are printed and finished the same day we arrive.

  4. 04

    Easy to live with

    Wipes clean with soap or glass cleaner, and can be painted over whenever your brand changes.

Process

Three steps. Nothing prints until you say so.

01

Send a photo

A photo of the wall, rough dimensions, and your artwork or logo. That's all we need to quote.

02

Approve the proof

We mock your design onto your wall. Revise it until it's right. Nothing prints until you approve.

03

We print on site

We bring the printer to you. Minimal prep, minimal mess, and most walls are finished the same day.

$25
per square foot, to start.

Final pricing depends on wall height, surface, location and site access. Quotes are free, and we reply within 24 hours.
